why: 2026-11-12: 'Clemens Family Campground' is a directory name for the Noonan Lions Club campground, not a separate private park. Google Maps resolves the name to the Lions campground place (48.8860077,-103.0063517, 505 Main St, 3.5 on 2 reviews, 47 m from 6004's pin); the ndtourism listing's pin (48.886477,-103.005819, seen as a search snippet only, ndtourism never read) is 90 m from 6004; wheretostayamerica.com (undated, (c) 2024) says it is 'Operated and maintained by the Noonan Lions Club'. No other trace: no operator site, no own Google listing, not on RV Life, not on the ND HHS licensed list (07.17.2025; Divide County's only Noonan row is NOONAN LIONS RV PARK, 7 lots).
name: Clemens Family Campground
flags: Address conflict: the directories give '600 Farm to Market Road', which is the Divide County address of 15697 Baukol-Noonan Trout Pond and Campground (4.4 km ESE), while the pin is on 6004's Main St lot. Either way the name maps onto an existing entry (6004 most likely, 15697 possible); no third campground exists in any source.

Directory claim not used: wheretostayamerica.com says '20 RV Sites with 30-amp and 50-amp services' and '$10 per night tenting', undated and unsourced; HHS licenses the Lions park for 7 lots and 6004 stores count 7, so nothing on 6004 was changed.
Had it been a separate private park it would also fail the presence/price rule: no website, phone, rate, booking page, RV Life listing or Google listing of its own.
Google 'Clemens campground Noonan' also returns 'Clemens Dropoff Point' (412 Hagerud St, 701-570-1555), a different business, not a campground.

Phone list (low priority, only if a Noonan call is already being made): Noonan Lions Club / 701-925-3000 - is 'Clemens Family Campground' the Lions campground on Main St or the camping loop at the Baukol-Noonan trout pond, and how many electric sites (directories say 20 with 30/50 A, HHS says 7 lots)?
